video_title: Brown Vs Celtics FEUD Continues, Mitchell Gets Huge Extension + DeRozan Waived: Joining a CONTENDER?

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce claims he could dominate in the NBA Summer League
quotes.excerpt: I can get you a dub in Summer League right now. I can get you 20 in Summer League right now.
quotes.quote: Right now, I can get you a dub in Summer League right now. I can get you 20 in Summer League right now. I have been watching. You can put me on any team in Summer League right now and I can get you a dub.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green explains why Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown don't hang out
quotes.excerpt: As adults, you are grown, guys have families. You do not hang out a lot at home.
quotes.quote: Jayson Tatum was rehabbing, and he also has a young baby. As adults, you are grown, guys have families. You do not hang out a lot at home. Most of the hanging out is on the road. If Jayson Tatum is not traveling with the team, going to dinners, and hanging out, he is not going to see him as much.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce believes Jayson Tatum is a stretch four in the modern NBA
quotes.excerpt: I think he is a stretch four now. Because as an older player, it is tougher for him.
quotes.quote: He is sort of in that position like I was in in Washington. I think he is a stretch four now. Because as an older player, it is tougher for him to keep up with the young athletic wings and all the 40 minutes of the game. And plus, they are not posting him up at the four anyway.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre discusses the management decision to trade Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: We do not think you are worth the type of deal that you think you deserve anymore.
quotes.quote: That was basically management being like, we do not think you are worth the type of deal that you think you deserve anymore. And on his way out, it was not like my teammates. To me, it just means more that we know it did not get out from the Jayson Tatum side. It got out from the Jaylen Brown side, that like, I had no relationship with this dude.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the telephone game of NBA rumors
quotes.excerpt: By the time it gets to Christian, that shit is, oh, Danny was doing this, this and this.
quotes.quote: You know how it goes when the telephone game is played. If I tell you one thing, you tell Paul, another thing, he tells Christian. By the time it gets to Christian, that shit is, oh, Danny was doing this, this and this. That is not what I said.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce argues that teams only need one superstar to win
quotes.excerpt: We are seeing that you only need one superstar to win it all now.
quotes.quote: We are seeing that you only need one superstar to win it all now. You know, we played in an era where you needed for sure two superstars or for sure three superstars. Now we are in an era like when you look at Oklahoma City, you see Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, a superstar. The second best player, Jalen Williams, he is an All-Star but not a superstar.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green questions if NBA teams are valuing role players over superstars
quotes.excerpt: Is the league organization valuing the role players more than the superstars right now?
quotes.quote: Is the league organization valuing the role players more than the superstars right now? Is that the direction that some teams are going in? We need more depth.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce discusses Donovan Mitchell's contract extension with the Cavaliers
quotes.excerpt: Donovan Mitchell has agreed to a four-year, 273 million dollar contract extension.
quotes.quote: Donovan Mitchell has agreed to a four-year, 273 million dollar contract extension. The seven-time All-Star had two seasons remaining on his contract and could have waited to resign next summer. He is definitely standing on business.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce believes the Cavaliers will be competitive with Donovan Mitchell
quotes.excerpt: If Cleveland remains in the mix, they beat the number one seed in the East.
quotes.quote: If Cleveland remains in the mix, they beat the number one seed in the East. They remain in that mix and remain competitive year in and year out. He more than lived up to his deal, in my opinion.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre discusses the Kings waiving DeMar DeRozan
quotes.excerpt: The Kings waived six-time All-Star DeMar DeRozan, making him the top free agent on the market.
quotes.quote: The Kings waived six-time All-Star DeMar DeRozan, making him the top free agent on the market, not named LeBron James. The decision was largely financial, as DeMar was due to make 25.7 million next year, with only 10 million of that being guaranteed.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green suggests the Pistons as a landing spot for DeMar DeRozan
quotes.excerpt: He is a vet, he knows how to score, knows how to get to his mid-range.
quotes.quote: He is a vet, he knows how to score, knows how to get to his mid-range, to get to his spots, to get to the free throw line, can calm your team down and keep you poised. I mean, a Detroit.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce views DeMar DeRozan as a stretch four
quotes.excerpt: I think he is a four now. Like a stretch four.
quotes.quote: I think he is a four now. Like a stretch four and it is just all about is he going to be coming off the bench or is he is he a starter at this stage of his career because you know you start based on who you can guard.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green notes the Nuggets' need for ball-handling
quotes.excerpt: I know for a fact they are looking for more ball-handling.
quotes.quote: I know for a fact they are looking for more ball-handling. That was something they felt like they were deficient in last year where like very susceptible to like full court pressure on Murray and stuff because like as much as Jokic orchestrates the offense, he does not bring the ball up.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce names Caleb Wilson as his rookie of the year
quotes.excerpt: I got him as my rookie of the year when I look at the opportunity he is going to get.
quotes.quote: I got him as my rookie of the year when I look at the opportunity he is going to get because I do not really expect Sabonis to be there when the season starts. And even Zach LaVine can be in the trade market as the Kings look to go younger and rebuild.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green identifies Caleb Wilson as a potential breakout rookie
quotes.excerpt: I am looking at Caleb Wilson. I think he will have a lot of opportunity in Chicago.
quotes.quote: I am looking at Caleb Wilson. I think he will have a lot of opportunity in Chicago. I think he has a fair shot to do some good things this year. He stays healthy, he is in Chicago, they do not have a lot going on, he could be the featured guy that they are growing.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce explains why he is not surprised by Dereck Lively's odds
quotes.excerpt: I am not shocked that Dereck Lively is the favorite, but I would not have thought that.
quotes.quote: I am not shocked that Dereck Lively is the favorite, but I would not have thought that because of the situation he is in. So many veterans, so many veterans that he is going to have to defer to.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo discusses his fear of change and legacy
quotes.excerpt: I am scared of change. I am scared that the grass is not always greener.

text_blocks.speaker: Giannis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I am scared of change. I am scared that the grass is not always greener. People love me here. People respect me here. People allow me to be myself here in the city. I am scared that I might never find that ever again.

text_blocks.speaker: Paul Pierce
text_blocks.text: You have earned that. You will always be welcomed here.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce comments on Giannis Antetokounmpo's retirement tour
quotes.excerpt: Setting up the retirement tour already?
quotes.quote: Setting up the retirement tour already? You are not cool with this now?

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce reflects on Kyle Lowry's legacy with the Raptors
quotes.excerpt: Kyle Lowry is retiring. He did a ceremonial signing of a one-day just as you did, Paul.
quotes.quote: Kyle Lowry is retiring. He did a ceremonial signing of a one-day just as you did, Paul, one-day contract with the Raptors to announce said retirement, so that he could retire as a Raptor. The Raptors revealed that his number seven jersey will be retired, rightfully so.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyle Lowry's message to the fans about his Raptors career
quotes.excerpt: You are not just playing for Toronto. You are playing for Halifax, Calgary, British Columbia.
quotes.quote: You are not just playing for Toronto. You are playing for Halifax, Calgary, British Columbia. You are playing for the whole country. It is hard to explain, but it is just an amazing place to be.

quotes.summary_phrase: Evaluating the roster construction of the hypothetical Team W
quotes.excerpt: There's too much shooting and inside work.

text_blocks.speaker: Paul Pierce
text_blocks.text: They got the, yeah. There's too much shooting and inside work.

text_blocks.speaker: Danny Green
text_blocks.text: Team W got Wardell, and Wilt, and Bill. Like, bro, what?

text_blocks.speaker: Wosny Lambre
text_blocks.text: It's the greatest shooting and inside work. Metta World Peace, and Steph, and Ray, and Treys. Metta could shoot too, though, by the way. He had a jump shot when he was playing, and an incredible defender.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce critiques his own team's lack of three-point shooting
quotes.excerpt: I needed a better three. That's what I needed.
quotes.quote: I needed a better three. That's what I needed. You got silver though, Danny, the team. I needed like a solid, like another shooter at the three. That's what I needed.
